name: std::shared_lock<Mutex>::release
intro:
Breaks the association of the associated mutex, if any, and *this.

No locks are unlocked. If the *this held ownership of the associated mutex prior to the call, the caller is now responsible to unlock the mutex.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the associated mutex or a null pointer if there was no associated mutex.

summary: Breaks the association of the associated mutex, if any, and *this.
